title: Past a mute, a mention of the viewer lights the @ of a row with a pre-mute message without moving it; a lagging answer keeps the @, a read past it clears it
why: RisingWave keeps the row at its last pre-mute message (rw_inbox_serving_v9: latest_activity_seq is the muted prefix's latest_seq when there is one) and lights has_mention from the mention arm (rw_inbox_mention_v7). So a muted mention (moves: false) lights the @ and leaves the position and unread as they are. An answer at the same position sent before the mention reached the server has no @: the mention is applied above that answer's position, so it is applied again and the @ stays. A read through the mention clears it. A mention-only row moves with its mentions instead (mention_only_stays_on_mention). Decided: Tenny, #triage:#244, 2026-11-16 (follow RisingWave).
